messages:
mika: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem. Capturing remediation items and owners so we don't drift. Main failure modes: uneven route withdrawal in us-east, missing backup manifests for a small subset of AZs, and unclear restore ownership during the warm-standby drill.

raj: I'll own R-100 (route withdrawal tuning + deploy gating). Plan: add a 10s withdraw grace, add a canary that simulates a region loss during deploys. ETA 2026-04-11, ticket OPS-5020.

ellie: I'll take R-101 (backup manifest + verify). Adding a daily manifest checksum job and an on-demand restore smoke test that runs in staging. ETA 2026-03-29, job=JENK-910.

kevin: I'll handle R-102 (restore playbook clarity). I'll add a pre-restore checklist, explicit KMS access verification, and a one-command helper to run main restore steps. Draft doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-restore/draft ETA 2026-04-03.

mika: proposed drill cadence update: weekly tabletop for 3 weeks starting 2026-04-06, then a full warm-standby failover in eu-west on 2026-04-22 (2h). calendar-bot: Event created -> "Warm-standby failover (eu-west)" 2026-04-22 14:00 UTC (organizer: mika)

ellie: adding telemetry tag failure_class=partial-withdraw to help spot recurring patterns. Will add to Datadog and to the weekly digest.

raj: short config example I'll include in the RFC:
```bash
# BGP withdraw grace example
bgp withdraw-grace 10
# healthcheck grace extended
set http-check timeout 12s
```

ops-bot: Reminder: please attach runbook lint results to DOCS-502 before closing.

mika: action tracker snapshot: R-100 route tuning owner=raj ETA=2026-04-11 ticket=OPS-5020; R-101 backup verify owner=ellie ETA=2026-03-29 job=JENK-910; R-102 runbook owner=kevin ETA=2026-04-03 doc=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-restore/draft

ellie: ack :thumbsup:

raj: ack

kevin: ack. I'll update the shared tracker and post weekly status on Mondays.

mika: closing thread for now, will reopen if blockers arise.
